plan_name: 扩展人工验收最小修复计划

constraints: paper authors and standard metadata/full-text-state fields are server-mapped and bounded
DOI compatibility is limited to verified paper external_id spans
at most one generation retry and no repeated Planner/Connector/MCP/tool call
DeepSeek failure cannot be represented as Template success
general Citation Guard thresholds remain unchanged

citation_display_sequence.repair_contract: Preserve the server-authored source_id through Citation DTO and render the same marker; only legacy responses missing source_id may use positional fallback.

innovation_empty_sources.fixed_current_plan: 比较正常认证与重放检测的事件序列、检测命中和误报，仅使用课程隔离日志。
innovation_empty_sources.fixed_followup_answer: 以检测命中率、误报率和事件序列差异为指标，使用同一批隔离日志建立正常组、重放组和消融对照组；不接触公网目标，也不使用真实用户数据。
innovation_empty_sources.fixture_rule: Prepare at least one relevant, trusted, provenance-complete case through normal upload/index or trusted Connector flow; never write the database directly or lower relevance/trust gates.

anonymous_teacher_deep_link.security_finding: No data leak and no backend RBAC defect
anonymous_teacher_deep_link.repair_contract: Direct Streamlit page execution calls render(), while anonymous/non-teacher gates and backend RBAC remain unchanged.

backend/agent/orchestrator.py: route any required trusted single external source to GroundedSpanAnswer without changing pure-course or Practice paths
map bounded paper authors and standard metadata/local-verification fields while preserving NVD mapping
reuse evidence for at most one grounded generation retry
disable successful Template fallback for externally grounded DeepSeek failures
persist redacted Guard failure tuples and bounded parse diagnostics
backend/llm/prompts.py: define GroundedSpanAnswer contracts for paper, vulnerability, standard, and project identity/exact spans
state that standard metadata is not verified standard full text
place bounded server retry feedback in actual provider messages
backend/guards/citation_guard.py: add narrow verified-paper DOI external_id compatibility
add redacted failure_detail for general grounded validation
do not change general support, relevance, or token thresholds
backend/schemas.py: add backward-compatible Citation.source_id response field and require new server responses to populate it
frontend/pages/student.py: render citation cards with server source_id and use positional fallback only for legacy missing-field responses
frontend/pages/teacher.py: invoke render() only when the page file is directly executed; retain existing login/role gates

allowed_test_files.tests/test_r3_grounded_answer_contract.p: single-source structured routing, prompt and actual provider messages
allowed_test_files.tests/test_s2_multi_source_citations.py: DOI, standard identity, required-source coverage and Guard negatives
allowed_test_files.tests/test_agent_orchestration.py: metadata mapping, retry/tool counts, Template fail-closed and redacted observability
allowed_test_files.tests/test_student_frontend_session.py: source marker/card identity and legacy fallback
allowed_test_files.tests/test_teacher_frontend_session.py: new anonymous deep-link red/green and role-gate tests

forbidden_changes: innovation algorithms, aliases, relevance thresholds, or provenance trust gates
global tool budget or business timeouts
treating standard metadata as verified full text
logging keys, Authorization headers, candidate bodies, complete private chunks, or Pydantic input/ctx
red_green_tests: paper authors and standard state fields become bounded spans while NVD fields remain unchanged
trusted exact DOI passes and forged, wrong-type, URL-derived, or wrong-span DOI fails
attempt-1 ValidationError records only bounded loc/type diagnostics
retry changes actual provider messages and does not repeat upstream calls
two invalid candidates still abstain and Template does not report success
S2 remains S2 through API and citation card
anonymous teacher direct page displays login gate and makes no business API request
student and teacher role behavior remains authorized

run_order: one final full pytest with a fresh isolated basetemp

command_9E_fixed_inputs.paper: 请使用真实论文搜索检索 5G core network attack detection，返回 3 篇论文的标题、作者、摘要线索和可核验来源链接；不要用本地论文样例代替真实联网结果。
command_9E_fixed_inputs.nvd: 请查询 NVD 中的 CVE-2021-44228，给出 CVE 编号、描述、严重性或 CVSS、CWE（若来源提供）、发布时间和 NVD 官方链接；不要提供利用步骤。
command_9E_fixed_inputs.github_regression: 请使用真实 GitHub 项目搜索查找 Open5GS mobile core，给出仓库全名、简介和可核验链接；不要执行或下载仓库代码。
command_9E_fixed_inputs.standard: 请查询 3GPP TS 33.501 的标准元数据和官方链接，并说明当前是否有经过核验的本地标准全文。
command_9E_fixed_inputs.multi_source: 请检索并综合真实的 5G 安全论文、NVD 中的 CVE-2021-44228 漏洞记录，以及 GitHub 上的 Open5GS 开源项目。请基于各自来源给出可核验的原子事实、逐项引用和实验建议。
command_9E_fixed_inputs.upload_citation: 请仅根据刚上传的课程资料，原样复述包含 F8-DIAG-UPLOAD-A 的完整一句，并显示引用和来源。
command_9E_fixed_inputs.innovation_current_plan: 比较正常认证与重放检测的事件序列、检测命中和误报，仅使用课程隔离日志。
command_9E_fixed_inputs.innovation_followup: 以检测命中率、误报率和事件序列差异为指标，使用同一批隔离日志建立正常组、重放组和消融对照组；不接触公网目标，也不使用真实用户数据。

review_challenges_for_9C: single external structured routing must not capture pure-course or Practice paths
metadata mapping must be bounded and prompt-injection resistant
DOI acceptance must remain bound to trusted paper external_id spans
standard metadata must not support standard full-text claims
retry feedback must reach actual provider messages without repeated tools
Template must not mask external grounded DeepSeek failure
Guard and parse diagnostics must be useful without retaining sensitive text
new Citation.source_id must be populated for new responses and legacy fallback must not rebind sources
teacher page entrypoint must not double-render under frontend/app.py
innovation acceptance must use relevant trusted evidence without threshold relaxation
9E must remain targeted and preserve one-run failure evidence

rollback.external_grounding: Revert the scoped orchestrator/prompt/Guard edits together and rerun directed plus full regression.
rollback.citation_display: Revert orchestrator, response schema, frontend rendering, and associated tests as one contract unit.
rollback.teacher_deep_link: Revert only the direct-entry guard and its new tests.
